verdict.label: LIKELY_WRONGFUL
verdict.summary: Your claim of ₹2,45,000 was wrongly rejected by Star Health and Allied Insurance Co. Ltd. under Clause 7.2 for non-disclosure. Your policy has completed 64 months of continuous coverage, which surpasses the statutory 60-month moratorium period under Section 45 of the Insurance Act. The insurer cannot repudiate this claim without establishing fraud.

facts.insurer_name: Star Health and Allied Insurance Co. Ltd.
facts.rejection_reason_text: Your claim is repudiated under Clause 7.2 (Disclosure to Information Norm) on grounds of non-disclosure of pre-existing hypertension at the time of proposal.
facts.cited_clause_text: Disclosure to Information Norm (Code- Cond02): The policy shall be void and all premium paid hereon shall be forfeited to the Company in the event of misrepresentation, mis-description or non-disclosure of any material fact.

rules.name: Section 45 Moratorium Period
rules.explanation: The policy has completed 64 months of continuous coverage without break, which exceeds the statutory 60-month moratorium ceiling under Section 45 of the Insurance Act, 1938 and IRDAI Master Circular 2024. No claim can be repudiated on grounds of misstatement or non-disclosure after expiry of 60 months unless fraud is established.
rules.law_ref: Insurance Act 1938 Section 45 & IRDAI Master Circular 2024 Para 12
